description: Revenue Floor configuration (packages/revenue_ops). Reviewed config: change it through review, then bump version. It holds published facts and tunable rules only. Owner decisions an offer still lacks are supplied when the operator approves the offer through the authenticated API, and that approval is bound to the digest of the full offer.

consent_note: [LEGAL REVIEW] A working rule set built from the text of S.C. 2010, c. 23, not legal advice. Confirm it with counsel before the first live send. Consent from conspicuous publication (s.10(9)(b)) is not supported because it turns on facts this system cannot check. The age limits are set a few days inside the statutory periods.

content_policy.note: Every number in a message must come from the approved offer, the sender identity, or the message's own dates and references. Every link must be the website or booking link in the Revenue settings.

connector_inventory.method: The Claude connector list plus read-only calls from the build session. A record of that check, not a live status: re-check before relying on it.

connectors.name: Gmail
limits: The connected account is not the business mailbox published on the website: it holds no mail addressed to that address.

connectors.name: Microsoft 365 (Outlook)
limits: Installed in claude.ai with its connection incomplete. Its tools are not available to any session.

connectors.name: Calendly
limits: One active event type, a 30-minute video meeting.
Routing forms need a Calendly Teams plan: the read was refused.

connectors.name: PayPal
can: create_invoice (opens a form a person completes)
send_invoice (opens a form; does not return the invoice id)
list_invoices (read; statuses DRAFT, SENT, SCHEDULED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, MARKED_AS_PAID, CANCELLED, REFUNDED, UNPAID, PAYMENT_PENDING)
list_transactions (read; status S, P, V, D; at most 31 days per call)
limits: No refund, capture, or payment-link tool.
No invoice or transaction record existed to observe, so the raw record shape is unverified; payment imports take a normalized record plus the raw record.

connectors.name: Stripe
limits: The website's live Payment Links point to Stripe. Payments made through them cannot be checked from here until the connector is reconnected and an import path is built.

connectors.name: HubSpot
limits: No CRM is connected. Revenue Floor opportunity records are the pipeline of record.

connectors.name: Finance plugin data warehouses
limits: BigQuery refused the sign-in method; no warehouse holds ClearGlass sales data.

connectors.name: Crypto.com
limits: Market data only. Not a payment, invoicing, or accounting source.

connectors.name: AgentMail
limits: No inbox exists. An agent-owned address is not the business sending identity, so it is not used for customer mail.

connectors.name: General Legal
limits: Opening a matter is the owner's decision, not an agent action.
